```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
league_df <- readr::read_csv("data/laser_league_players.csv")
```

```{r}
hist_plot <- ggplot(league_df, aes(monthly_income)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(monthly_income, na.rm = TRUE)), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Income Distribution", x = "Monthly income", y = "Count")
hist_plot
```

```{r}
box_plot <- ggplot(league_df, aes(region, wellbeing_index)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "gray85") +
  labs(title = "Wellbeing by Region", x = "Region", y = "Wellbeing index") +
  theme_minimal()
box_plot
```

```{r}
scatter_plot <- ggplot(league_df, aes(volunteer_hours, energy_reduction_pct, color = commute_mode)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ internet_access) +
  labs(title = "Volunteer Hours vs Energy Reduction", x = "Volunteer hours", y = "Energy reduction (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
scatter_plot
```
